## Purpose and scope

Describe the change, affected rule IDs and consumer impact.

## Sources and decisions

Record official sources/ref/date, compatibility decisions and any proposed exception. A proposal is not an owner approval.

## Evidence

- Commands, environment and actual PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE results.
- Positive and intentional negative controls relevant to the change.
- Before/after screenshots or reports for visible/performance changes, actually inspected.
- Installation/update/rollback impact and a migration note where relevant.

## Review

- [ ] Existing user work, permissions and asset rights are preserved.
- [ ] No quality gate, assertion, budget or exception was weakened to make this change pass.
- [ ] Rule/installer changes have a changelog entry and consumer-impact review.
- [ ] Missing checks and blockers are reported accurately.
- [ ] External publication and account operations have the necessary authorization.
